en.description: A strange call comes from beyond and must not go unanswered.
en.name: The Lotus Eaters

zh.description: 奇异的呼唤从远方传来，不能置之不理。
zh.name: 食莲者

en.description: A chance to rewrite history and avert disaster.
en.name: The Hex Finale

zh.description: 一个改写历史、避免灾难的机会。
zh.name: 六人组终章

en.description: The desperate hunt for Albrecht Entrati has led the Drifter to the city of Höllvania on December 31st, 1999. Despite the Scaldra lockdown in the face of the Techrot menace, the citizens do their best to celebrate. But this has all happened before... and ended in disaster.
en.name: The Hex

zh.description: 1999 年 12 月 31 日，为了找到阿尔布雷希特·英择谛，漂泊者来到了霍瓦尼亚。尽管面对科腐者的威胁，炽蛇军实施的封锁，但市民们仍努力庆祝。但这一切曾经发生过……并以灾难告终。
zh.name: 六人组

en.description: Inspect your personal quarters upon finishing the Chains of Harrow quest.
en.name: Apostasy Prologue

zh.description: 完成 Harrow 系列任务后前去检查你的个人房间。
zh.name: 变节序言

en.description: The Balor Fomorians are coming but we are ready. Through your efforts we finally have a working Archwing prototype and I am sending you the blueprint. However, your task is not yet complete. You still must discover the component parts.
en.name: The Archwing

zh.description: 巴罗尔巨人战舰即将来袭，但我们已做好准备。通过你努力的成果，我们总算有了能实际运作的曲翼原型机，我将蓝图寄给你了。不过你的任务并未结束，你仍得搜索其他的组成部件。
zh.name: 曲翼

en.description: Build the Mandachord and find the cause of Cephalon Suda’s erratic behavior.
en.name: Octavia's Anthem

zh.description: 建造曼达和弦琴并查明中枢苏达异常行为的原因。
zh.name: Octavia 的赞歌

en.description: Investigate your personal quarters upon completion of The Sacrifice.
en.name: Chimera Prologue

zh.description: 完成《牺牲》系列任务后调查个人房间
zh.name: 虚妄嵌合序言

en.description: Unlocks access to your Clan's Dojo
en.name: Clan Key

zh.description: 解开进入氏族道场的权限
zh.name: 氏族钥匙

en.description: Work with Cephalon Simaris to find the source of a mysterious voice.
en.name: The New Strange

zh.description: 和中枢 Simaris 合作找出一个神秘声音的源头。
zh.name: 新疑谜团

en.description: Enter the Kingdom of Duviri
en.name: The Duviri Paradox

zh.description: 进入双衍王境
zh.name: 双衍悖论

en.description: Loid has had strange dreams and desperately needs to show you something.
en.name: Whispers in the Walls

zh.description: 洛德做了一些奇怪的梦，急需给你看一些东西。
zh.name: 墙中低语

en.description: New Loka seeks help protecting a sacred forest from Grineer incursions, but are they ready to face the forest's true nature?
en.name: The Silver Grove

zh.description: 新世间为保护一片神圣的森林不被 Grineer 入侵正寻求帮助，但是他们准备好面对这片森林真正的本性了吗？
zh.name: 落银树庭

en.description: Darvo needs your help again. Save one of his best contractors from Grineer execution.
en.name: A Man of Few Words

zh.description: Darvo 再次需要你的协助，从 Grineer 的刑罚中拯救出他最好的承包商。
zh.name: 沉默寡言的男人

en.description: On the Plains of Eidolon a mystery has lain buried for years: one that will mend or destroy a heart, and open the door to a hidden past.
en.name: Saya's Vigil

zh.description: 在夜灵平野中，一个秘密埋藏了许久：这个秘密可以治愈或毁灭人心，并将打开一道通往隐秘过去的大门。
zh.name: 萨娅的守夜

en.description: Ordis is determined to help a fellow Cephalon overcome a ship wide infestation.
en.name: The Jordas Precept

zh.description: Ordis 决意帮助一具中枢同伴压制一艘遭到广域性感染的船舰。
zh.name: Jordas 枢律

en.description: Nef Anyo has stolen the children of the Mycona Colony and it is up to you to get them back. You must challenge Nef on The Index and beat him at his own game. But Tenno, beware, not all is as it seems.
en.name: The Glast Gambit

zh.description: 奈富·安尤偷走了 Mycona 殖民地的孩子们，全靠你去解救他们了。你需要在指数之场中挑战 奈富，在他自己的游戏中击败他。但是注意了，Tenno，并不是一切都如看起来那么单纯。
zh.name: Glast 的千钧一策

names.zh: 异融阿拉德 V 刺杀

en.description: Put an end to Alad V and his Mutalist experiments
en.name: Mutalist Alad V Assassinate

zh.description: 突袭阿拉德 V 的研究船，终结他的异融者实验。
zh.name: 异融阿拉德 V 刺杀

en.description: Find Alad V's laboratory and put a stop to his madness.
en.name: Patient Zero

zh.description: 找到阿拉德 V 的实验室并制止他的疯狂行径。
zh.name: 零号病患

en.description: Intercepted Grineer communications reveal that Grineer have been experimenting with some sort of bio weapon. You must investigate.
en.name: Once Awake

zh.description: 拦截到的 Grineer 通讯显示，Grineer一直在试验某种生化武器，你必须调查清楚。
zh.name: 悲剧的开端

en.description: Deimos emerges in Martian orbit, completely overrun by the Infestation... yet among the writhing mass, a distress call comes over a most ancient carrier wave...
en.name: Heart of Deimos

zh.description: 火卫二出现在了火星轨道上，被大量感染者占领……然而在这些蠕动的生物体中，伴随着一道极古老的载波，传来了一个求救信号……
zh.name: 惊惧之心

en.description: Struggling to understand the oldest and deepest secret from his past, Stalker finds himself allied with sworn enemies on the troubling road toward uncovering the truth… and averting an incalculable loss.
en.name: Jade Shadows

zh.description: 为了了解他过去的陈年秘辛，追猎者发现自己在揭露真相的艰难道路上与死敌结盟……并避免了不可估量的损失。
zh.name: Jade 之影

en.description: When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequences of his own actions. The shadows of his future have come calling, and they are not alone.
en.name: Jade Shadows: Constellations

zh.description: 当 Hunhow 召唤追猎者前往奥布山谷参与一场正在展开的离奇冲突时，他必须面对自己行为所带来的令人震惊的后果。他未来的阴影正在召唤，而这些阴影并不孤单。
zh.name: 《Jade 之影：众星》

en.description: Daughter Entrati gets more than she bargained for when she enlists the Tenno to investigate a call for reinforcements aboard a Narmer Murex.
en.name: Veilbreaker

zh.description: 当英择谛“女儿”号召 Tenno 去调查合一众骨螺战舰上的一个增援请求时，她所收获的要比预想中的更多。
zh.name: 破障者

en.description: You are Tenno, you deserve a Kubrow by your side.
en.name: Howl of the Kubrow

zh.description: 你是 Tenno，你应要有一只库狛伴随。
zh.name: 库狛取得任务

en.description:
The Limbo Theorem quest cannot be completed without an Archwing

Piece together the Limbo Theorem to uncover its source
en.name: The Limbo Theorem

zh.description:
Limbo 定理任务必须具备曲翼才能完成

通过拼凑 Limbo 定理来揭露其起源
zh.name: Limbo 定理

en.description: Seek out the Warframe Mirage.
en.name: Hidden Messages

zh.description: 寻找 Mirage 战甲。
zh.name: 被隐藏的信息

en.description: Corpus incursions into Grineer territory lead to showdown with a forgotten rival.
en.name: The Teacher

zh.description: Corpus 入侵 Grineer 领土，却引发与一位被遗忘的劲敌的对决。
zh.name: 老师

en.description: Help Baro Ki'Teer raid an ancient Martian tomb for a mysterious treasure.
en.name: Sands of Inaros

zh.description: 帮 Baro Ki'Teer 突袭一座古老的火星古墓并偷盗一件神秘的宝物。
zh.name: Inaros 之沙

en.description:
The Tenno: monuments of an ancient warrior caste.

For generations you've slept, with no call to wake you.

Until now.
en.name: AWAKENING

zh.description:
Tenno：代表远古战士的不朽精锐。

世世代代，你长眠于此，无人唤醒你。

直到如今。
zh.name: 觉醒

en.description:
The Sentient armada has emerged from the Veil Proxima in shocking numbers.

At their head, Natah, once the trusted guide 'Lotus', now seemingly in thrall to Ballas and her brother Erra.

Across worlds and space, the Tenno and their unlikely alliance launch a final assault to take the Sentient mothership... where Natah awaits.
en.name: The New War

zh.description:
Sentient 舰队正以惊人的数量从面纱比邻星域中涌现。

领军的 Natah，曾是我们倍受信赖的向导 "Lotus"。而她现在似乎已被其亲弟 Erra，以及 Ballas 奴役。

横跨整个星系，Tenno 与他们意想不到的盟友，发动了最终强袭以攻占 Sentient 母舰。而 Natah……亦在舰中严阵以待。
zh.name: 新纪之战

en.description: The Sentient Hunhow seeks to destroy the Tenno by exploiting long forgotten secrets.
en.name: The Second Dream

zh.description: Sentient Hunhow 企图发掘一些被长久遗忘的秘密来毁灭 Tenno。
zh.name: 第二场梦

en.description: A strange transmission leads deep into the dark world of Red Veil mysticism. What evils will be found there and what do they want?
en.name: Chains of Harrow

zh.description: 一条奇怪的通信引向黑暗世界深处血色面纱的神秘。在那里会找到何种邪恶之物，而他们的目的又是什么呢？
zh.name: Harrow 的枷锁

en.description: A power struggle within the Corpus elite has erupted. Seeking control, Nef Anyo looks to the past... to the very origins of the Corpus itself.
en.name: The Deadlock Protocol

zh.description: Corpus 内部爆发了一场始于 Corpus 精英之间的权力斗争。为了夺取控制权的奈富·安尤着眼于过去……追溯到了 Corpus 自身的起源。
zh.name: 僵局协议

en.description: To face a growing threat, a long dormant Cephalon calls on you to reconstruct an Orokin-era interceptor craft: the Railjack.
en.name: Rising Tide

zh.description: 为了应对日益增长的威胁，一位长期处于休眠状态的中枢要求你重建一艘奥罗金时代的拦截战舰：航道星舰。
zh.name: 澎湃狂潮

en.description: The Unum chooses Nakak to receive a strange mask. A mask that leads to even stranger visions. What lost story does the Unum want to tell?
en.name: Mask of the Revenant

zh.description: 娜卡被乌努母神选中收到了一个奇怪的面具。这个面具引她看到了更奇怪的影像。究竟乌努母神想要诉说什么遗失的故事呢？
zh.name: Revenant 的面具

en.description: A tortured vision sends the Operator on the hunt for a Warframe unlike any other.
en.name: The Sacrifice

zh.description: 一个受折磨的景像使得指挥官开始寻找着一架不同于其他的战甲。
zh.name: 牺牲

en.description: Strange drones have appeared in the Origin System, help the Lotus find out what they are and who sent them.
en.name: Natah

zh.description: 行迹诡异的无人机出没于始源星系，协助 Lotus 追查出它们究竟是什么，又是谁派它们来的。
zh.name: Natah

en.description: Eudico would do anything to keep her people safe, but will she stand up to Nef Anyo?
en.name: Vox Solaris

zh.description: Eudico 为了她的人民的安全可以做出任何事情，但她会起身对抗奈富·安尤吗？
zh.name: 索拉里斯之声

en.description: Find the thief Maroo and uncover the secrets of the Arcane Codices.
en.name: Stolen Dreams

zh.description: 找到小偷 Maroo 揭开那些秘奧法典的秘密
zh.name: 被偷走的梦

en.description: Albrecht Entrati's trail leads beyond the Origin System. Only by delving into the past can the path ahead be made clear - but buried secrets can be deadly.
en.name: The Old Peace

zh.description: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的踪迹指向始源星系之外。唯有深入探究过去，才能厘清前路——但埋藏的秘密可能致命。
zh.name: 旧日和平

en.description: Find the Lotus in the Dark Refractory and seek her out within her memories.
en.name: Lua

zh.description: 在深溯池找到 Lotus，并在她的记忆中寻找她。
zh.name: 月球

en.description: The Vessel has awoken. Praghasa has returned. Deploy to the surface of Eris... fuel is required.
en.name: Vessel

zh.description: 承载体已经苏醒。「布拉喀萨」已回归。部署至阋神星表面……需要燃料。
zh.name: 承载体

en.description: Praghasa feasts.
en.name: Eris Mortem

zh.description: 布拉喀萨的盛宴。
zh.name: 阋神星之死

en.description:
My Queens, you were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR
en.name: Vor's Prize

zh.description:
我尊敬的女皇们，你们是正确的，Tenno 的威胁千真万确。我们找到一个 Tenno 漂浮在地球附近，但莲（Lotus）事先料到了我们的行动。就在我们要抓住 Tenno 之前，莲（Lotus）解除了冷冻睡眠，并派来一支 Tenno 小队破坏了我们的攻势。

他们逃跑了。我们正在追踪。只要将这个 Tenno 与大部队分开，就应该很容易干掉。我们已经击碎了其战甲外甲，并且如此突然地解除冷冻将对其记忆力造成损伤。

由于未能完成任务，我们不胜惶恐地等待应得的惩罚。

——沃尔
zh.name: 沃尔的战利品

en.description: A disturbance in the Somatic Link prompts the Lotus to send operatives back to the Tenno Reservoir.
en.name: The War Within

zh.description: 活体连接的干扰迫使 Lotus 派遣特工回到 Tenno 储梦池。
zh.name: 内战

en.description: Void Storms gather in Corpus lanes... could a mysterious vessel somehow be the cause?
en.name: Call of the Tempestarii

zh.description: 虚空风暴正在 Corpus 航道上聚集……难道是某艘神秘诡舰所造成的？
zh.name: 风暴的呼唤

en.description: When tragedy strikes, the Ventkids search for hope in a long-lost story.
en.name: The Waverider

zh.description: 当悲剧突然降临时，通风小子在一个失传已久的故事中寻找希望。
zh.name: 驭浪者

en.description: From depths beyond reason a Voice had spoken, and its echoes would not be denied. No longer fully concealed by the ever-shifting Void, the Zariman now rests between worlds. A haunting song resounds across the System. It is time for an overdue confrontation with the past...
en.name: Angels of the Zariman

zh.description: 一道声音从感知以外的幽深之处响起，其回响不容忽视。不再完全被变幻万千的虚空所掩盖，「扎里曼号」现在停泊于两界之间。荧惑的歌声在星系中回荡，是时候与过去开始一场早该进行的斗争了……
zh.name: 扎里曼的天使
